# agentops_outpost_install (Data Source)

Install information for an outpost — Helm chart coordinates, values YAML, and install/upgrade commands.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `outpost_id` (String) The outpost to get install info for.

### Read-Only

- `chart` (String) Helm chart reference.
- `command` (String) Helm install command.
- `credential_secret_key` (String) Key within the credential secret.
- `credential_secret_name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes secret holding credentials.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace for the release.
- `release_name` (String) Helm release name.
- `upgrade_command` (String) Helm upgrade command.
- `upgrade_values` (String) Helm values YAML for upgrade.
- `values` (String) Helm values YAML for initial install.
